summary: Fresh-context review of S-1. listNotes filters (new array, so the store is untouched) and sorts by createdAt descending, with case-insensitive tag filtering per default D-1. npm test passes 4/4. The diff touches only src/notes.mjs and tests/notes.test.mjs, inside the slice paths. No tests were weakened and no secrets or non-English text were found. Slice is non-UI, so no browser check was needed. One minor unguarded-input finding.

findings.issue: tag?.toLowerCase() throws a TypeError for a non-string truthy tag, and a null tag also throws on t.toLowerCase() path only if tags contain non-strings. Not covered by C-5, so not blocking.
findings.suggestion: Coerce or validate tag as a string.

criteria.note: Descending sort by createdAt verified by test.
filter creates a new array before sort; copy test passes and the new sort test asserts the store order is unchanged.
Tag filter returns only matching notes, case-insensitive per D-1.

browser.note: Slice is not UI-bearing; no browser verification required.
